items.title: Eye To Ad Media Opens Total Market Domination, Selling One Exclusive Industry Slot Per State on Its Business Directory Network
items.summary: One business per industry per state gets the pop-up and large banner placements on USABusinessSearch.com, plus COBusinessList.com for Colorado slots.
items.content_text: Denver-based Eye To Ad Media has opened Total Market Domination, an advertising package that sells one exclusive slot per industry in each state across the business directory network the company owns. When someone searches the network for an industry and a location in that state, such as "dentist Orlando" or "Omaha auto repair," the business holding the slot appears in a pop-up on the results, and its large banners sit on the matching search and category pages. The network covers USABusinessSearch.com nationwide and adds COBusinessList.com for Colorado. While a business holds a slot, no competitor in its industry can buy the same slot in that state. ## Why one slot per state Exclusive directory sponsorships are often sold by a local newspaper or chamber of commerce, one town or one print edition at a time. Total Market Domination works at state level instead. That suits companies that serve a whole state or several metros in one: a roofer covering the Front Range, an HVAC company working across Arizona, or a personal injury firm that would rather claim a practice area statewide than fight for one city at a time. > We built this for owners who win on call volume and are tired of sha

items.title: Aging Safely Baths Confirms Ella’s Bubbles Dealership, Putting Four Walk-In Tub Brands Under One BBB-Accredited Roof
items.summary: Aging Safely Baths is an Ella's Bubbles dealer, so families can compare Ella's Bubbles, Hydro Dimensions, Bestbath and Meditub tubs with one BBB-accredited company.
items.content_text: Aging Safely Baths has confirmed that it is a dealer for Ella's Bubbles walk-in tubs. With Ella's Bubbles in the lineup, the Denver-area company now offers four walk-in tub and accessible bathing brands: Hydro Dimensions, Ella's Bubbles, Bestbath (including the RANE by Bestbath line) and Meditub. A family can line up all four with one BBB-accredited company instead of booking a separate sales visit for each brand. The confirmation targets a familiar frustration. A household that wants to compare walk-in tubs often finds that each brand is sold by a different dealer, and every dealer recommends the brand it carries. That leaves the comparison to an adult child on a laptop or a parent with a stack of brochures. Carrying several brands lets one consultation answer the practical questions side by side: which door direction fits the room, how high the seat sits, how the tub will be heated and filled, and what the existing water heater can support. > Nobody should have to pick a brand before they know what fits the bathroom. items.title: Eye To Ad Media Opens a Press Release Network That Routes Each Release to the Local Sites It Fits
items.summary: Every release is now republished on a news site and routed by a public filter to the Colorado and Hawaii sites it fits, with a receipt.
items.content_text: Distribute Press Releases, the press release service operated by Denver-based Eye To Ad Media, now sends every release it publishes through a routing network. Each release is republished on the news site Action Global News with a canonical link back to the original. A filter then reads the release's industry, location and wording and places it on up to three sites where it fits. The network launches with five sites covering Colorado camping, Denver restaurants, Denver things to do, Colorado community news and Hawaii hotels. The filter's rules are public. A Denver restaurant opening goes to the Denver restaurant site, a camping gear launch goes to the camping site, and a Honolulu hotel announcement goes to the Hawaii site. Local sites only take local releases. Every placement keeps the original's paid or affiliated label, and every release gets a public receipt listing where it went, with a working link for each destination. > Most small companies pay for a press release and never find out where it went. items.title: Eye To Ad Media Begins Custom-Coding AI Agents for Small Businesses, Starting With Lead Response
items.summary: Denver-based Eye To Ad Media now custom-codes AI agents for small businesses, starting with lead response, with a person approving every action.
items.content_text: Eye To Ad Media, the Denver marketing firm founded in 2012, now custom-codes AI agents for small businesses. The first builds cover three jobs: answering new inquiries within minutes, running sales-trained assistants on company websites, and handling research and content workflows. Every build is restricted to information the business has approved, and a person signs off before anything reaches a customer. Off-the-shelf agents have become cheap or free this year, and the firm says that is the reason for the narrow focus. General-purpose tools work well when a business runs on mainstream software. The time a small company actually loses tends to sit between its own systems: a field-service CRM, a scheduling tool, a phone line and a spreadsheet that do not talk to each other. A custom agent is built to work in those gaps. > The free agents are good at common work on popular platforms. Most of the small businesses we talk to lose their time somewhere else, in the handoff between a form, a phone and a calendar. That handoff is what we build for, and nothing goes out without a person approving it. Zach Wennstedt, founder of Eye To Ad Media. ## How the builds work Each project starts wit

items.title: Aging Safely Baths Publishes a Six-Point Fit Check for Families Shopping for a Walk-In Tub
items.summary: Six measurements to take before requesting a walk-in tub quote, from doorway width to water heater capacity, published by the accessible bathing supplier.
items.content_text: Aging Safely Baths, a walk-in tub and barrier-free shower supplier operating since 2012, has published a six-point fit check for families shopping for a walk-in tub. The check covers the measurements and household details that decide whether a model will work. The company says most quote requests stall because one of them comes up after a model has been chosen. The fit check is aimed at the adult children and spouses who usually do the research. In the company's experience, they often start from a product photo rather than the bathroom. > People fall in love with a tub online and then find out it won't go through the bathroom door. Ten minutes with a tape measure saves weeks. Measure first, then shop. Zach Wennstedt, founder of Aging Safely Baths. ## The six-point fit check **1. The alcove.** Measure the length, width and height of the space the current tub occupies. Many walk-in tubs are sized for a standard alcove, which can let the existing plumbing stay where it is. **2. The path in.** Measure every doorway and hallway turn between the front door and the bathroom. The tub has to travel that route in one piece. **3. items.title: Aging Safely Baths Explains Curbed vs. Barrier-Free Showers for Households Replacing a Bathtub
items.summary: When a low curb is enough and when a true zero-threshold shower is worth the floor work, from a Bestbath dealer that has installed both since 2012.
items.content_text: Aging Safely Baths, an authorized Bestbath dealer that has supplied accessible bathing products since 2012, has published guidance for households replacing a bathtub with a shower. The guidance covers the choice between a low-curb shower and a true barrier-free, zero-threshold shower. It explains what each requires underneath the floor and who each one suits. Replacing a tub with a shower is one of the most common accessibility projects in the home. The company says the decision is often made on looks, when the deciding factors are how the person bathing gets in and what the floor will allow. > A low curb is fine for someone who walks in steadily. A wheelchair or a rolling shower chair needs no curb at all, and that is a floor question before it is a product question. Find out what your floor will let you do, then pick the shower. Zach Wennstedt, founder of Aging Safely Baths. ## When a low curb works A curbed shower with a low threshold suits people who walk on their own or with a cane, especially with a grab bar at the entry.
